Instructions for Use
Device description: The Tern Neuromodulation System is a sacral neuromodulation system. It is available in lengths from 15 mm to 28 mm.
Warnings: For single use only. Do not resterilize. Store at 15 °C to 30 °C.
Refer to the surgical technique guide for implantation instructions.

MRI Information
Non-clinical testing has demonstrated that the Tern Neuromodulation System is MR Conditional. A patient with this device can be safely scanned in an MR system meeting the following conditions:
• Static magnetic field of 3.0 T
• a maximum spatial field gradient of 720-Gauss/cm or less
• Gradient slew rate limited to 150 T/m/s per axis
• Maximum MR system reported, whole body averaged specific absorption rate (SAR) of 1.2 W/kg (Normal Operating Mode)
• Any receive-only coil may be used
• Device configuration: MRI SureScan mode
Under the scan conditions defined above, the Tern Neuromodulation System is expected to produce a maximum temperature rise of less than 2.4 °C after 15 minutes of continuous scanning.
In non-clinical testing, the image artifact caused by the device extends approximately 2 mm from the device when imaged with a gradient echo pulse sequence and a 3-Tesla MR system.
